bodyHtml:
📱 Phones, Tablets & Wearables · Logan & Surrounds

Mobile Device Setup Logan. Smartphones, Tablets & Smartwatches, Done Right.

Seamless setup for iPhones, Androids, iPads and wearables, on-site or remote. Ideal for new device owners, senior users, families and small businesses. We make sure your new device is configured correctly from the start, so everything works seamlessly, securely and efficiently.

Set Up My Devices
✓ Account & Device Setup
✓ Data Migration
✓ Security & Backup
✓ One-On-One Training
What's Included

Full Initial Setup & Device Configuration.

Covering all major smartphones, tablets and smartwatches, power-on to fully ready.

  • Power-on & activation. First-time setup done properly.
  • Account setup. Apple ID, Google Account, or Samsung/Android login.
  • Language & accessibility settings. Configured for how you'll actually use it.
  • WiFi, mobile data & Bluetooth connection. Connected and tested.
  • Initial device sync & software updates. Up to date from day one.
📱

Mobile Phones

iPhone, Samsung Galaxy, Google Pixel, Huawei, Oppo.

📲

Tablets

iPads, Samsung, Lenovo and TCL Android tablets.

⌚

Smartwatches

Apple Watch, Galaxy Watch, Fitbit, Garmin.

Data Migration

Switching Devices? We Move Everything Across Safely.

Whether you're moving from Apple to Android or Android to iPhone, your data is transferred securely and synced across devices, contacts, photos and videos, files and documents, calendar entries, call history and SMS messages, and your apps and user settings. We can also set up ongoing sync to Google Drive, iCloud or OneDrive, and link your devices with computers, tablets and smart TVs.

Email & App Setup

Email, Apps & Accounts, Fully Configured.

We set up multiple email accounts and folders across Gmail, Outlook, Hotmail, Yahoo and Exchange, with notifications and sync configured properly. App configuration covers everything from Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and TikTok through to banking, government and workplace apps like MyGovID, Service QLD and Microsoft 365. Unwanted apps removed on request to free up storage.

Security & Backup

Your Device, Locked Down And Backed Up.

Secure your personal data with built-in mobile security settings and cloud-based backup tailored to your privacy and safety needs.

  • Secure password creation. With account recovery options set up.
  • Biometric login. Face ID or fingerprint scanner configured.
  • Lock screen & timeout settings. Set to sensible defaults.
  • Privacy permissions for apps. Reviewed and locked down.
  • Scheduled backups. iCloud, Samsung Cloud, or Google One configured.
  • Find My iPhone / Android Device Manager. Set up in case of loss or theft.

Want your accounts locked down properly across the board, not just on your phone? See our full password manager & 2FA setup service.

One-On-One Training

New To Your Device? We'll Show You The Ropes.

Get friendly, one-on-one guidance to master the basics, optimise usage, and feel confident using your smartphone or tablet, in person or remotely, tailored to your needs.

  • Navigating menus and settings. With simplified, senior-friendly instructions.
  • Written or printable guides. Available on request.
  • Downloading and managing apps. Safely and confidently.
  • Calls, texts and camera. The everyday basics covered clearly.
Related Services

Getting Your Whole Household Set Up?

Setting up a phone alongside a new computer? Check out our new computer setup service. Want to keep the whole family safe online once devices are configured? We also offer family safety & screen time solutions. Locked out of an old account during the switch? See our account recovery services. And to make sure everything stays backed up long-term, take a look at data backup & transfer.

Frequently Asked Questions

Mobile Device Setup Questions, Answered.

How do I set up my new smartphone or tablet?

Setup includes powering on the device, connecting to networks, logging into your accounts, configuring settings, and installing essential apps.

Can I transfer data from my old phone?

Yes, data transfer includes contacts, apps, messages, photos and settings using secure, efficient methods tailored to your device.

Is remote setup available?

Yes. Setup can be completed remotely via secure software for clients across Logan and beyond.

How long does setup usually take?

Most standard setups take between 30 and 60 minutes. Data-heavy migrations may take longer.

Do you offer training for seniors or non-tech users?

Absolutely. Personalised guidance is provided with patience and plain-English instructions.

Is my personal data protected during the setup?

Yes. Security and privacy are top priorities, no data is viewed without permission, and sensitive info is never stored.

Set Up Your Device The Right Way.

Everything in place, fully protected, and personalised for your needs, on-site or remote.

Set Up My Devices
